payload.taskDescription: Replace README.md with the easy-host README: one-paragraph description, the three supported stacks, host prerequisites summary with a link to the operations guide, the three install paths, a five-command quickstart, the four success scenarios, a safety note about volumes, and a documentation index. Create tests/docs/links.test.ts to verify relative links resolve, required headings exist, and every command named in the README exists in the CLI. The test must also fail if the README still contains react-hoster branding outside the migration note.
